node_definition.done_when: The report under the run directory first reproduces the failure at base and names its cause with evidence: the watch-seat lock error, an environment the test reads outside the repository, or a real defect in the refusal it pins. A test-side cause is fixed in tests/test_scoring_dispatches_its_review.py; if the cause is in product code, stop blocked and name the change. The test then passes five times out of five alone at head, in an exclusive all_debug sbatch job with checkouts under the run's scratch directory, and also on the fleet node. The negative control restores the cause and the test reproduces its failure. Every other test in the file passes unchanged. Every log is written under the run directory, carries rev=, host= and the literal command, and ends in EXIT=. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the changed file, recorded in a log.
node_definition.goal: Make tests/test_scoring_dispatches_its_review.py::test_an_unattached_session_refuses_the_automatic_dispatch_too pass at head for the reason it names, after establishing why it fails
